Most security models assume the client is trustworthy.
MitM attacks exploit that assumption.

https://t.co/DWPllZmlja https://t.co/oIduiUDP0w

Password rules ≠ security.
People still use predictable patterns, reuse passwords, and rely on personal info — making them easy targets.
Attackers don’t break systems, they exploit users (phishing, fake logins, session hijacking).
Real defense = MFA + awareness + smart behavior.
